name: bathke-aegis
description: Bathke Aegis — Experimental AI-Assisted XDR/SIEM Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @aegis/api" "npm run dev -w @aegis/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @aegis/api -w @aegis/web -w @aegis/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @aegis/domain && npm run build -w @aegis/contracts
